description: Triage up to 10 CIS counterparties as one caller-supplied chain. Returns independent per-item results, partial input errors, the highest exposure signal, and mandatory human-review routing. Required tool arguments: requests. Grades supplied evidence; it does not independently verify source truth. Obtain the source records requested by inputSchema before asking for a decision-ready result. Do not fabricate missing evidence. For a Middle Corridor sanctions question without evidence, use corridor_sanctions_assistant at https://corridor-sanctions-assistant.agendamcp.dpdns.org/mcp/agent for orientation only. Illustrative example arguments (synthetic; replace with your own data): {"requests":[{"counterparty":{"name":"Example Trading LLP","jurisdiction":"KZ","sector":"trading_house"},"exposure_facets":["ownership_or_control","transit_or_re_export"],"dated_sources":[{"id":"cis-1","source_type":"ofac_sdn_extract","title":"OFAC SDN extract","date":"2026-08-01"},{"id":"cis-2","source_type":"ownership_chain_evidence","title":"Ownership chain memo","date":"2026-08-04"}],"risk_question":"Is this counterparty ready for onboarding review under secondary-sanctions exposure?","decision_stage":"onboarding"}]}. This product offers 2 free trial attempts for cis_secondary_sanctions_exposure: call MCP free_trial_status, then MCP free_trial with that tool's own inputSchema arguments; no HTTP adapter or wallet is needed. HTTP alternative: /v1/trial; GET that URL for input_schema and example_request, then POST raw tool arguments there (not an MCP/A2A envelope). HTTP, MCP and native A2A share the allowance and daily capacity is limited. Other tools are not included in this trial. Evaluation on paid endpoints requires Base USDC payment or Pro access. Standard x402 v2, when enabled, signs a one-transfer authorization and durably binds its first admitted request. Legacy payment uses a funding-wallet signature over the exact request. Discovery is free. Keep the original request and X-Payment-Signature for result recovery within 24 hours. Current prices: https://cis-secondary-sanctions.agendamcp.dpdns.org/.well-known/x402. Do not pay automatically. Evidence triage only: no factual-truth verification, no legal, compliance, sanctions, or financial advice. Human review is required before any commercial action.
